q.id: Ongkir menurut berat (kg, bilangan bulat): 1-5 = Rp10.000, 6-20 = Rp25.000, 21-50 = Rp60.000. Berat di bawah 1 atau di atas 50 ditolak. Berapa test minimal agar setiap partisi (valid dan tidak valid) tercakup sekali?
q.en: Shipping fee by weight (kg, integers): 1-5 = 10,000, 6-20 = 25,000, 21-50 = 60,000. Weights below 1 or above 50 are rejected. What is the minimum number of tests to cover each partition (valid and invalid) once?

exp.id: Ada tiga partisi valid dan dua partisi tidak valid (di bawah 1, di atas 50), total lima. Satu nilai wakil per partisi: misalnya 0, 3, 10, 30, 51.
exp.en: There are three valid and two invalid partitions (below 1, above 50), five in total. One representative per partition, e.g. 0, 3, 10, 30, 51.

q.id: Panjang password valid 8 sampai 16 karakter. Kumpulan nilai panjang mana yang mencakup semua partisi dengan EP?
q.en: A password is valid with 8 to 16 characters. Which set of lengths covers all partitions using EP?

exp.id: Ada tiga partisi: di bawah 8 (tidak valid), 8-16 (valid), di atas 16 (tidak valid). Nilai 5, 10, 20 masing-masing mewakili satu partisi. Set lain hanya menyentuh satu atau dua partisi.
exp.en: There are three partitions: below 8 (invalid), 8-16 (valid), above 16 (invalid). The values 5, 10, 20 each represent one partition. The other sets touch only one or two partitions.

q.id: Diskon belanja (Rupiah, bilangan bulat): total < 100.000 = 0%, 100.000-499.999 = 5%, >= 500.000 = 10%. Total negatif tidak valid. Set input mana yang mencakup semua partisi dengan jumlah test paling sedikit?
q.en: Shopping discount (Rupiah, integers): total < 100,000 = 0%, 100,000-499,999 = 5%, >= 500,000 = 10%. A negative total is invalid. Which input set covers all partitions with the fewest tests?

exp.id: Partisinya: negatif (tidak valid), 0-99.999, 100.000-499.999, dan >= 500.000, jadi empat nilai wakil sudah cukup. Opsi kedua melewatkan partisi tidak valid; opsi ketiga mengandung dua nilai pada partisi yang sama dan tidak ada yang negatif; opsi keempat memakai lima nilai.
exp.en: The partitions are negative (invalid), 0-99,999, 100,000-499,999 and >= 500,000, so four representatives suffice. The second option misses the invalid partition; the third has no negative value; the fourth uses five values.

q.id: Partisi usia untuk tarif tiket: 0-17, 17-64, 65 ke atas. Apa kelemahan pembagian ini?
q.en: Age partitions for ticket prices: 0-17, 17-64, 65 and above. What is wrong with this split?

id: Usia 17 masuk dua partisi: partisinya tumpang tindih
Jumlah partisinya terlalu sedikit untuk tarif tiket
Usia 65 sama sekali tidak tercakup oleh partisi
Partisi ekuivalen dilarang memuat rentang nilai
en: Age 17 is in two partitions: they overlap
The number of partitions is too few for ticket pricing
Age 65 is not covered by any partition at all
Equivalence partitions are forbidden from holding ranges

exp.id: Partisi ekuivalen harus saling lepas (tidak tumpang tindih) dan lengkap. Nilai 17 ambigu: masuk 0-17 atau 17-64? Perbaiki menjadi 0-17, 18-64, 65 ke atas.
exp.en: Equivalence partitions must be disjoint (no overlap) and complete. The value 17 is ambiguous: 0-17 or 17-64? Fix as 0-17, 18-64, 65 and above.

q.id: Syarat: usia harus lebih dari 17 dan kurang dari 66 (bilangan bulat). Nilai uji BVA dua nilai yang benar?
q.en: Rule: age must be greater than 17 and less than 66 (integers). Which are the correct two-value BVA test values?

exp.id: Rentang valid bilangan bulat adalah 18-65. Dua-nilai BVA: batas dan tetangga di luar rentang, yaitu 17, 18 dan 65, 66. Kesalahan umum adalah memakai angka dalam kalimat (17 dan 66) sebagai batas valid.
exp.en: The valid integer range is 18-65. Two-value BVA: each boundary and its neighbour outside the range, i.e. 17, 18 and 65, 66. A common slip is treating the numbers in the sentence (17 and 66) as the valid boundaries.

q.id: Tarif jarak (km, bilangan bulat): 0-10, 11-25, 26-100; di luar itu tidak valid. Berapa nilai berbeda yang diperlukan untuk BVA dua nilai di seluruh partisi?
q.en: Distance fee (km, integers): 0-10, 11-25, 26-100; anything else is invalid. How many distinct values are needed for two-value BVA across all partitions?

exp.id: Nilai: -1, 0, 10, 11, 25, 26, 100, 101. Batas yang bersebelahan (10|11 dan 25|26) berbagi nilai sehingga totalnya 8, bukan 12.
exp.en: Values: -1, 0, 10, 11, 25, 26, 100, 101. Adjacent boundaries (10|11 and 25|26) share values, so the total is 8, not 12.

q.id: Kolom harga menerima 0,01 sampai 999,99 (dua desimal). Nilai uji BVA dua nilai yang benar?
q.en: A price field accepts 0.01 to 999.99 (two decimals). Which are the correct two-value BVA test values?

exp.id: Tetangga ditentukan oleh presisi (dua desimal), jadi tetangga 0,01 adalah 0,00 dan tetangga 999,99 adalah 1000,00. Memakai bilangan bulat mengabaikan presisi kolom.
exp.en: Neighbours are set by precision (two decimals), so the neighbour of 0.01 is 0.00 and of 999.99 is 1000.00. Using integers ignores the field's precision.

q.id: Spesifikasi: 'user berusia 18 tahun atau lebih boleh mendaftar'. Developer menulis if (usia > 18). Nilai uji mana yang mendeteksi defect ini?
q.en: Spec: 'users aged 18 or older may register'. The developer wrote if (age > 18). Which test value detects this defect?

exp.id: Defect off-by-one: 18 seharusnya diterima tetapi ditolak. BVA menargetkan tepat jenis defect ini. Nilai 17, 19, dan 40 berperilaku sama pada kode benar maupun salah.
exp.en: An off-by-one defect: 18 should be accepted but is rejected. BVA targets exactly this kind of defect. 17, 19 and 40 behave the same on correct and faulty code.

q.id: Persetujuan pinjaman: tiga kondisi (kredit baik, pendapatan cukup, punya utang lain), semua Ya/Tidak. Bila kredit tidak baik, hasil selalu 'tolak' apa pun kondisi lain. Berapa kolom aturan setelah kolom digabung?
q.en: Loan approval: three conditions (good credit, enough income, other debt), all Yes/No. If credit is not good, the outcome is always 'reject' whatever the other conditions. How many rule columns remain after collapsing?

exp.id: Kredit tidak baik digabung menjadi satu kolom (kondisi lain 'tidak peduli'). Kredit baik memakai 2 x 2 = 4 kolom. Total 1 + 4 = 5, bukan 8.
exp.en: Bad credit collapses into a single column (the others are 'don't care'). Good credit uses 2 x 2 = 4 columns. Total 1 + 4 = 5, not 8.

q.id: Decision table memakai dua kondisi: 'pesanan sudah dibayar' dan 'pesanan sudah dikirim'. Kombinasi 'dikirim tetapi belum dibayar' mustahil menurut aturan bisnis. Berapa test case untuk coverage semua aturan yang layak?
q.en: A decision table uses two conditions: 'order is paid' and 'order is shipped'. The combination 'shipped but unpaid' is impossible by business rules. How many test cases cover all feasible rules?

exp.id: Tabel penuh punya 4 kolom, satu di antaranya tidak mungkin terjadi sehingga dikeluarkan. Sisa 3 aturan layak, masing-masing diuji.
exp.en: The full table has 4 columns, one of which cannot occur and is dropped. The remaining 3 feasible rules are each tested.

q.id: Premi asuransi: pengemudi di bawah 25 tahun dan punya riwayat kecelakaan = +50%; hanya salah satu dari keduanya = +25%; tidak keduanya = tarif dasar. Seorang pengemudi 30 tahun punya riwayat kecelakaan. Hasil yang diharapkan?
q.en: Insurance premium: a driver under 25 with an accident history = +50%; only one of the two = +25%; neither = base rate. A 30-year-old driver has an accident history. Expected result?

exp.id: Usia 30 berarti kondisi 'di bawah 25' tidak terpenuhi, sedangkan riwayat kecelakaan terpenuhi. Tepat satu kondisi benar sehingga +25%.
exp.en: Age 30 means 'under 25' is not met while the accident history is. Exactly one condition is true, so +25%.

q.id: Sebuah decision table dengan tiga kondisi Ya/Tidak hanya punya tujuh kolom: YYY, YYN, YNY, YNN, NYY, NYN, NNY. Apa masalahnya?
q.en: A decision table with three Yes/No conditions has only seven columns: YYY, YYN, YNY, YNN, NYY, NYN, NNY. What is the problem?

id: NNN hilang, jadi tabel tidak lengkap
Ada satu kolom yang muncul sebagai duplikat
Tabel seharusnya hanya memiliki enam kolom saja
Tidak ada masalah; tabel itu sudah lengkap
en: NNN is missing, so the table is incomplete
One column appears as a duplicate of another
The table should only have six columns in total
No problem; the table is already complete

exp.id: Tiga kondisi biner menghasilkan 2^3 = 8 kombinasi. Yang hilang adalah NNN; kombinasi yang terlewat berarti perilaku tidak terdefinisi dan tidak teruji.
exp.en: Three binary conditions give 2^3 = 8 combinations. NNN is missing; a missing combination means undefined, untested behaviour.

q.id: Akun: Active -(3x gagal login)-> Locked; Locked -(unlock)-> Active; Active -(close)-> Closed; Locked -(close)-> Closed. Closed tidak punya transisi keluar. Ada 3 state dan 3 event. Berapa pasangan (state, event) yang tidak valid?
q.en: Account: Active -(3 failed logins)-> Locked; Locked -(unlock)-> Active; Active -(close)-> Closed; Locked -(close)-> Closed. Closed has no outgoing transitions. There are 3 states and 3 events. How many (state, event) pairs are invalid?

exp.id: Total pasangan 3 x 3 = 9; transisi valid ada 4, sehingga 5 tidak valid (mis. unlock saat Active, gagal login saat Locked, semua event saat Closed). Pasangan tidak valid ini diuji sebagai negative test.
exp.en: Total pairs 3 x 3 = 9; there are 4 valid transitions, so 5 are invalid (e.g. unlock while Active, failed login while Locked, every event while Closed). These invalid pairs are tested as negative tests.

q.id: Artikel: Draft -(submit)-> Submitted; Submitted -(approve)-> Approved; Approved -(publish)-> Published; Submitted -(reject)-> Rejected; Rejected -(edit)-> Draft. Setiap urutan dimulai dari Draft. Berapa urutan test minimal agar semua transisi valid tercakup?
q.en: Article: Draft -(submit)-> Submitted; Submitted -(approve)-> Approved; Approved -(publish)-> Published; Submitted -(reject)-> Rejected; Rejected -(edit)-> Draft. Every sequence starts at Draft. What is the minimum number of test sequences to cover all valid transitions?

exp.id: Urutan 1: submit, approve, publish. Urutan 2: submit, reject, edit. Keduanya bersama menutup kelima transisi. Satu urutan tidak cukup karena reject dan approve keluar dari state yang sama.
exp.en: Sequence 1: submit, approve, publish. Sequence 2: submit, reject, edit. Together they cover all five transitions. One sequence is not enough because reject and approve leave the same state.

q.id: Pada model artikel di atas, sebuah test menjalankan: Draft, Submitted, Rejected, Draft, Submitted, Approved. Berapa transisi berbeda yang tercakup?
q.en: In the article model above, a test runs: Draft, Submitted, Rejected, Draft, Submitted, Approved. How many distinct transitions does it cover?

exp.id: Ada 5 langkah, tetapi submit dari Draft ke Submitted terjadi dua kali. Transisi berbeda: submit, reject, edit, approve = 4.
exp.en: There are 5 steps, but submit from Draft to Submitted occurs twice. Distinct transitions: submit, reject, edit, approve = 4.

q.id: Model pesanan: Pending -(pay)-> Paid; Paid -(refund)-> Refunded; Pending -(cancel)-> Cancelled. Test mengirim event pay, refund, lalu pay lagi. Perilaku yang benar untuk event pay terakhir?
q.en: Order model: Pending -(pay)-> Paid; Paid -(refund)-> Refunded; Pending -(cancel)-> Cancelled. A test sends pay, refund, then pay again. What is the correct behaviour for the last pay event?

id: Ditolak: Refunded tidak punya transisi pay
Diterima, lalu pesanan kembali ke state Paid
Diterima, lalu pesanan masuk ke state Pending
Event itu menghapus seluruh data pesanan
en: Rejected: Refunded has no pay transition
Accepted, and the order returns to the Paid state
Accepted, and the order moves to the Pending state
The event deletes the whole order record

exp.id: Model tidak punya transisi pay dari Refunded, jadi event itu harus ditolak dan state tetap Refunded. Ini negative test klasik untuk transisi tidak valid.
exp.en: The model has no pay transition from Refunded, so the event must be rejected and the state stay Refunded. A classic negative test for an invalid transition.

q.id: Kode: if (A) { s1 } lalu if (B) { s2 } (tanpa else). Satu test dijalankan dengan A = benar dan B = benar. Berapa statement coverage dan branch coverage?
q.en: Code: if (A) { s1 } then if (B) { s2 } (no else). One test runs with A = true and B = true. What are the statement and branch coverage?

exp.id: Kedua statement dieksekusi (100%). Ada dua keputusan, masing-masing dua cabang (benar/salah) = 4 cabang; test hanya menjalankan dua cabang 'benar' = 50%. Perlu test kedua dengan A dan B salah.
exp.en: Both statements run (100%). There are two decisions with two branches each (true/false) = 4 branches; the test only takes the two 'true' branches = 50%. A second test with A and B false is needed.
